title: Docs: install b4 from the MarkAtwood/b4 fork
description: Mark 2026-10-23: b4 fork created at github.com/MarkAtwood/b4, branch git-vouch (bfba0af: configurable patatt recheck window, keyring label, misc/vouch-check.sh). Guides should install b4 from the fork next to the patatt fork (pip install 'b4 @ git+https://github.com/MarkAtwood/b4@git-vouch'), recommend b4.attestation-recheck-hours = 0 as fork config (not released b4), and point to misc/vouch-check.sh. Upstream submission stays held (vouch-mzkw.9). Doc test: like test_the_install_line_installs_the_tested_fork, assert the b4 install line resolves to the tested fork commit; run the guides' blocks against the fork (B4 fork clone) so revocation is immediate with recheck-hours = 0.
acceptance_criteria: Guides' b4 install line and config tested against origin/git-vouch of MarkAtwood/b4; revocation test shows no cached pass with recheck-hours = 0; tests pass on 3.12 and 3.9; ruff clean.
